messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Audit category boundaries. Prefer existing carriers and the smallest executable circuit over new orchestration.

The Union's mathematical substrate admits opaque marks once, pairs a token mark with a claim mark as an Utterance, recursively articulates/predicates/posites it into FOUR-valued witnessed structure, and uses FCA derivation/closure, Hoare preservation, and distal-bypass obstruction classification to derive most answers. Finance already realizes an economic CommodityUtterance as an exact ordered (token, claim) payload, separate WitnessBitProduction, content-addressed finite trace and lot, local FOUR assay, customer effect, border-price offers, and replay-idempotent formation. Pymetrologic already supplies executable FCA, closure-rule, Chu, Hoare-adjacent, and settling algorithms. Existing free-compute-dev instead takes prose coding objectives, tries a tiny hand-coded resolver registry, then routes model tool actions through LISS; it learns via lexical overlap and JSONL trajectory counts. LISS properly owns cheapest-sufficient hosted model/device inference and Claude escalation, but currently treats all suppliers as language-model endpoints. EVM services already supply sovereign ERC-1271/EIP-712 enterprise accounts, mutually signed recursive Chu-Hoare effect cells, and an on-chain HolonomySeamLedger; x402 tollbooth exists but truthfully lacks broadcast. Constraint: the Union itself should be understood as an inference engine. Each unresolved need is a typed token/claim obligation. Existing deterministic derivations/services must be attempted first; only typed residue that cannot close deterministically is sold to an inference actuator service (free cloud/local GPU first, Claude when required). Returned claims require independent customer assay. EVM holds boundary authority, contracted seams, replay protection, receipts, and settlement commitments; JSON/Node are projections or adapters, not the authoritative market. No global work pool, coding-only scope, provider assertion, or monolithic distal-bypass artifact. Identify the smallest first executable circuit using these exact carriers, what should be retired or demoted from free-compute-dev, and the strongest category-error counterexample.

firstCircuit: Form Utterance: bind opaque token_mark × claim_mark in Finance CommodityUtterance ordered payload
Emit WitnessBitProduction: content-address (token, claim) into local Finance lot, assign trace id
Run Pymetrologic FOUR assay: evaluate claim against witnessed lot context, yield {T, F, ⊥, ⊤}
Attempt FCA closure: derive concept lattice over Finance lot; test whether claim intent is covered by an existing extent
If closed: emit Hoare-preserved Finance trace; route to EVM Chu-Hoare effect cell for mutual seam signing
If residue (⊥/⊤, no FCA cover): dispatch typed residue token to LISS cheapest-sufficient actuator — local GPU, then cloud GPU, then Claude
Customer assay: independently re-run Pymetrologic FOUR assay on actuator-returned claim against original lot; reject if witness chain breaks
EVM settlement: record assayed claim in HolonomySeamLedger with replay-idempotent nonce; x402 tollbooth enforces border-price at ingress
deterministicBoundary: FCA derivation and closure: any Finance lot with fully witnessed context closes typed obligations without actuator dispatch
Hoare triple verification: replay-idempotent Finance trace formations checked structurally against pre/postcondition pairs
Chu-space morphism checking: effect cell compatibility verified algebraically before mutual EVM signing
Content-address deduplication: lot/trace identity against existing Finance store — no actuator needed when trace already exists
Border-price offer matching: deterministic accept/reject against EVM-signed criteria with no model inference
WitnessBitProduction from existing FOUR-witnessed claims: bit derivation is a projection, not an inference step
actuatorBoundary: Novel opaque mark interpretation: utterances whose claim intent has no covering extent in the current FCA lattice
Partially witnessed predication residue: FOUR states ⊥ or ⊤ that FCA cannot collapse from the current Finance lot
Novel lot/trace articulation: Finance formations not derivable by Hoare-preserved replay from existing traces
Distal-bypass obstruction classification for topologically novel seam configurations with no prior concept match
evmBoundary: Sovereign account authority: ERC-1271 validation and EIP-712 structured-data binding — no other layer holds this
Mutual seam commitment: Chu-Hoare effect cell dual signing; JSON/Node are read-only projections of this record
HolonomySeamLedger: canonical ordered settlement; replay-idempotent nonce commit is the authoritative market state
x402 tollbooth: border-price enforcement at ingress (broadcast gap must close before first live circuit run)
Obstruction receipts: on-chain record of distal-bypass classification; provider assertion is not a substitute
retireOrDemote: RETIRE: global work pool — all work is a typed token/claim obligation routed by type, not pooled by availability
RETIRE: provider assertion — EVM boundary authority is the sole validity witness
RETIRE: monolithic distal-bypass artifact — decompose into per-seam typed residue routing
DEMOTE: hand-coded resolver registry → Pymetrologic FCA/closure as primary resolver; registry becomes bootstrap shim only
DEMOTE: coding-only scope → scope is any typed token/claim obligation; code is one carrier, not the category
DEMOTE: LISS treating all suppliers as LM endpoints → LISS must discriminate supplier type before dispatch

Suppose a Finance lot already holds a Hoare-preserved trace T whose FCA intent covers obligation O. The correct derivation closes O deterministically. free-compute-dev instead dispatches O to Claude, receives generated claim C*, and records C* without customer FOUR assay — coding-only scope treats code output as self-evidencing. Three simultaneous errors: (1) actuator used where deterministic closure existed, wasting budget and breaking residue-last; (2) C* bypasses independent FOUR assay — a generated claim is not a derived claim, severing the witness chain; (3) coding-only scope exempts C* from EVM seam signing, reducing EVM to a logging adapter. Constructive: any Finance lot with a closed FCA concept covering an incoming claim falsifies the proposition that LISS dispatch is ever the correct first step.
